innodb_purge_threads.description: The number of background threads devoted to the InnoDB purge operation.

max_connections.description: The maximum permitted number of simultaneous client connections.

innodb_log_buffer_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer that InnoDB uses to write to the log files on disk.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer pool, the memory area where InnoDB caches table and index data.

innodb_page_cleaners.description: The number of page cleaner threads that flush dirty pages from buffer pool instances.

innodb_lru_scan_depth.description: Influences the algorithms and heuristics for the flush operation for the InnoDB buffer pool.

innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct.description: InnoDB tries to flush data from the buffer pool so that the percentage of dirty pages does not exceed this value.

innodb_log_file_size.description: The size in bytes of each log file in a log group.

binlog_group_commit_sync_delay.description: Controls how many microseconds the binary log commit waits before synchronizing the binary log file to disk.

binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count.description: Sets the maximum number of transactions to wait for before aborting the current binlog_group_commit_sync_delay wait.

innodb_lock_wait_timeout.description: The length of time in seconds an InnoDB transaction waits for a row lock before giving up.

innodb_stats_persistent_sample_pages.description: The number of index pages to sample when estimating cardinality and other statistics.

innodb_read_io_threads.description: The number of I/O threads for read operations in InnoDB.

optimizer_search_depth.description: The maximum depth of search performed by the query optimizer. Values larger than the number of relations in a query result in better query plans, but take longer to generate an execution plan.

tmp_table_size.description: The maximum size of internal in-memory temporary tables.

max_heap_table_size.description: This variable sets the maximum size to which user-created MEMORY tables are permitted to grow.

innodb_flush_log_at_timeout.description: Write and flush the logs every N seconds.

sort_buffer_size.description: Each session that must perform a sort allocates a buffer of this size.
